title: Physical Intelligence Opens Pi API Beta for Robot Fine Tuning
summary:
Various partner companies are already using Physical Intelligence's π models to automate tasks such as strawberry harvesting and server assembly. The firm is now broadening access to its Pi API, enabling external developers to customize and fine-tune these models for their own robotic hardware.

The company opened the beta program to a wider group of teams to increase the scale of testing for the interface across diverse industries. Interested developers can apply for access through a signup process to adapt the model foundations to specific applications.
